categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文从训练策略、评测可靠性到合成数据质量，都在追问"我们到底在优化什么"。

articles.title: Generative AI in Turbulence: Foundations, Applications, Validations and Benchmarks
articles.zh: 湍流中的生成式AI：基础、应用、验证与基准
articles.summary: 如果你想把生成模型用到流体仿真里，这篇综述把湍流场景下的方法、验证手段和benchmark都梳理了一遍，能省掉不少踩坑时间
articles.author: Luca Biferale, Michele Buzzicotti
articles.body: Generative AI offers new approaches to turbulence problems in which incomplete observations or unresolved d.o.f. admit multiple physically plausible solutions. Potential applications include stochastic closures, super-resolution, data assimilation, uncertainty quantification, and the generation of Eulerian and Lagrangian flow ensembles. However, turbulence is not a conventional image-generation problem. Its multiscale dynamics, intermittency, extreme events, rough velocity fields and intrinsically stochastic transport make visual realism, pointwise error, and low-order spectral agreement insufficient measures of physical fidelity. We examine where generative AI provide novel capabilities with emphasis on diffusion models, score-based methods, and related probability-transport formulations. We discuss their use in unconditional generation, probabilistic reconstruction, reduced-order modeling, temporal evolution, and mesh-free representations. We argue that validation must address turbulence properties: energy transfer, structure functions, anomalous scaling, pdf tails, coherent structures, conservation laws, temporal consistency, ensemble diversity and generalization. Finally, we discuss potential limitations in validation, baseline, data availability and reproducibility, and the need for a benchmark ecosystem combining open data, standardized challenges, hidden tests, physics-aware metrics, and documented failures. This paper serves as a bridge between two communities. For AI practitioners, we provide a fair and accessible introduction to turbulence, essential for appreciating the challenges posed by the field and for assessing the physical relevance of generative models. For turbulent practitioners, we provide an introduction to the key technological aspects of Generative AI, clarifying what these tools actually do, and where their potential and current limitations lie.
articles.bodyZh: 生成式人工智能（Generative AI）给湍流问题带来了新路子：当观测不完整，或者有些自由度（d.o.f.）没解析出来时，可能存在好几个物理上都说得通的解。可能的应用包括随机闭合（stochastic closures）、超分辨率（super-resolution）、数据同化（data assimilation）、不确定性量化（uncertainty quantification），以及生成欧拉和拉格朗日流动系综（Eulerian and Lagrangian flow ensembles）。不过，湍流可不是那种常规的图像生成问题。它有多尺度动力学（multiscale dynamics）、间歇性（intermittency）、极端事件（extreme events）、粗糙速度场（rough velocity fields），还有本质上随机的输运（intrinsically stochastic transport）；所以光看视觉真实感（visual realism）、逐点误差（pointwise error）和低阶谱一致性（low-order spectral agreement），根本不够衡量物理保真度（physical fidelity）。我们会看看生成式AI到底在哪些地方带来了新能力，重点放在扩散模型（diffusion models）、基于得分的方法（score-based methods），以及相关的概率输运表述（probability-transport formulations）上。也会聊它们在无条件生成（unconditional generation）、概率重建（probabilistic reconstruction）、降阶建模（reduced-order modeling）、时间演化（temporal evolution）和无网格表示（mesh-free representations）里的用法。我们认为，验证（validation）必须对准湍流自己的性质：能量传递（energy transfer）、结构函数（structure functions）、反常标度（anomalous scaling）、概率密度函数尾部（pdf tails）、相干结构（coherent structures）、守恒律（conservation laws）、时间一致性（temporal consistency）、系综多样性（ensemble diversity）和泛化（generalization）。最后，我们会讨论验证、基线（baseline）、数据可得性和可复现性方面可能有哪些局限，也会说要建一个基准生态系统（benchmark ecosystem），把开放数据（open data）、标准化挑战（standardized challenges）、隐藏测试（hidden tests）、物理感知指标（physics-aware metrics）和记录在案的失败案例（documented failures）合到一起。这篇文章想在两个圈子之间搭座桥。对AI从业者，我们给一个公平、好懂的湍流入门，帮他们体会这个领域到底难在哪，也帮他们判断生成模型在物理上到底有没有意义。对湍流从业者，我们介绍生成式AI的关键技术面，讲清楚这些工具实际在干什么，潜力在哪，眼下的局限又在哪。

articles.title: Quality over Quantity: Rethinking Data and Model Assumptions for Bengali Coreference Resolution
articles.zh: 质量胜过数量：重新审视孟加拉语指代消解中的数据与模型假设
articles.summary: 如果你在做低资源语言的NLP，这篇提醒你别再靠堆数据量硬撑，数据和模型假设的重新设计可能更划算
articles.author: Zenith Biswas, Andrew Thomas Dyer
articles.body: Multilingual transformer models are often assumed to generalise across languages, but their effectiveness for coreference resolution in low-resource settings remains unverified. We investigate this gap in Bengali, a language with over 250 million speakers but limited annotated coreference resources. We evaluate transformer-based pre-trained encoders under multiple settings, including zero-shot, fine-tuning, data augmentation, and cross-lingual transfer. Our results challenge several common assumptions about model generalisation and data efficiency in low-resource NLP. We demonstrate that a small amount of high-quality annotated data significantly outperforms larger mixed-quality datasets (p < 0.01). We find that data augmentation, particularly back-translation, does not improve performance and can degrade results in coreference resolution. Cross-lingual transfer is also inconsistent: transfer from a distant language like English reduces performance, and transfer from the related language Hindi provides no consistent benefit across models. Several widely used multilingual models exhibit collapsed embedding spaces, rendering them unsuitable for similarity-based clustering tasks. These findings highlight the importance of annotation quality over data quantity and provide empirical guidance for developing coreference resolution systems in low-resource languages.
articles.bodyZh: 大家常常默认多语言 Transformer 模型（multilingual transformer models）能跨语言通用，但它们在低资源场景下做指代消解（coreference resolution）到底好不好用，其实还没被验证。我们盯上了孟加拉语这个空白：它有超过 2.5 亿使用者，但带标注的指代消解资源很有限。我们在多种设置下评估了基于 Transformer 的预训练编码器（pre-trained encoders），包括零样本（zero-shot）、微调（fine-tuning）、数据增强（data augmentation）和跨语言迁移（cross-lingual transfer）。结果挑战了低资源自然语言处理（NLP）里关于模型泛化和数据效率的几个常见假设。我们发现，少量高质量标注数据明显胜过更大规模的混合质量数据集（p < 0.01）。我们还发现，数据增强——尤其是回译（back-translation）——并不能提升效果，在指代消解里甚至可能让结果变差。跨语言迁移也不稳定：从英语这种距离较远的语言迁移会拉低表现，而从相关语言印地语迁移，在不同模型上也没有稳定收益。几个常用的多语言模型出现了嵌入空间坍塌（collapsed embedding spaces），导致它们不适合做基于相似度的聚类任务（similarity-based clustering）。这些发现说明，标注质量比数据数量更重要，也为低资源语言里开发指代消解系统提供了实证指导。

articles.title: UTA: Universal Training Adaptive Learning Rate Decay
articles.zh: UTA：通用的训练自适应学习率衰减
articles.summary: 如果你每次训练都在手调学习率schedule，这个方法试图把衰减策略自动化，省掉一轮超参搜索
articles.author: Anda Tang, Junjie Wang 等
articles.body: Learning rate decay (LRD) is critical for training high-performance models, yet most designs remain empirically driven. Although the Universal Budget Aware (UBA) LRD offers a theoretical framework, its reliance on SGD dynamics limits its applicability to modern Adam-type optimizers and leaves its key `optimization difficulty parameter' opaque. To bridge this gap, we propose the Universal Training Adaptive (UTA) LRD. Unlike UBA's fixed offline trajectory anchored solely to iterations, UTA treats LRD as a closed-loop shape-and-scale problem. By continuous-time formulation, UTA is training-state adaptive with segment-wise optimal shape. This adaptivity links external iterations with internal training states, enabling a near-optimal path in both progression shape and learning rate (LR) scale, a property unattainable by other LRDs, including UBA. Empirically, we demonstrate consistent improvements across language models (LLaMA 60M to 1B) and vision models (ResNet50, ViT-B) on ImageNet with plug-and-play ease and negligible overhead. Extensive ablation studies further confirm UTA's robustness across dimensions, including peak LR, final decay ratio, its parameter $\varphi_0$, component efficacy and generalization to fine-tuning scenarios, underscoring its practical implementability.
articles.bodyZh: 学习率衰减（Learning rate decay, LRD）对训练高性能模型至关重要，但大多数设计还是靠经验驱动。通用预算感知（Universal Budget Aware, UBA）LRD 虽然提供了一个理论框架，但它依赖随机梯度下降（SGD）的动力学，这就限制了它在现代 Adam 类优化器上的适用性，也让关键的“优化难度参数”一直不够透明。为了补上这个缺口，我们提出了通用训练自适应（Universal Training Adaptive, UTA）LRD。和 UBA 那种只按迭代次数固定好的离线轨迹不同，UTA 把 LRD 看成一个闭环的“形状+尺度”问题。通过连续时间建模，UTA 能随训练状态自适应，并做到分段最优的形状。这种自适应性把外部迭代和内部训练状态连了起来，让训练在推进曲线形状和学习率（learning rate, LR）尺度上都接近最优——这是包括 UBA 在内的其他 LRD 做不到的。实验上，我们在语言模型（LLaMA 60M 到 1B）和视觉模型（ResNet50、ViT-B）上、在 ImageNet 上都能稳定看到提升，而且即插即用、额外开销几乎可以忽略。大量消融实验也进一步确认了 UTA 在多个维度上的稳健性，包括峰值学习率、最终衰减比例、它的参数 $\varphi_0$、各组件是否有效，以及在微调场景里的泛化能力，说明它确实有实际落地性。

articles.title: Subspace Crystallization in Grokking: Rank Compression Tracks the Phase Transition
articles.zh: Grokking中的子空间结晶：秩压缩追踪相变过程
articles.summary: 如果你对grokking这个玄学现象好奇，这篇用秩压缩的视角解释模型从死记硬背转向泛化的那一刻究竟发生了什么
articles.author: Shlok Mehendale, Paras Chopra
articles.body: Grokking describes understanding something deeply and intuitively. In neural networks, it is the phenomenon where a network generalizes long after memorizing its training data. This delay has been linked to a fall in the effective rank of the network's weight matrices, but whether this rank compression drives grokking or follows it is still unresolved. We study a mean-field MLP and a one-layer transformer trained on modular arithmetic and observe that: (i) Compression follows the onset, not memorization. Every transformer memorizes its training data within 250 steps, while the grokking onset (the first step at which test accuracy reaches 95%) varies from 6,500 to 21,000 steps. The steepest fall in effective rank comes about 900 steps after the onset, however late the onset occurs, and networks that memorize without grokking compress far less. (ii) Subspace crystallization. We call the span of the fewest top singular directions of a weight matrix that preserve 99% of test accuracy its sufficient subspace. Its size can shrink as the margin between the correct and the best wrong output grows, so we also count the directions needed to keep the outputs within 10%. In the transformer, this count falls during the transition from a quarter or more of the available directions to about a tenth, which we call subspace crystallization. (iii) Imposing low rank does not speed up grokking. Against a factorized full-rank control, capping the rank of the transformer's MLP input weights delays the onset, and capping the rank of its embedding stops 15 of 20 runs from grokking. Compression is therefore a signature of grokking rather than its cause.
articles.bodyZh: 顿悟（Grokking）指的是能深入、凭直觉地理解一件事。放到神经网络里，它说的是：网络先把训练数据背下来，很久之后才突然学会泛化。这个延迟一直被认为跟网络权重矩阵（weight matrices）的有效秩（effective rank）下降有关，但到底是这种秩压缩推动了顿悟，还是顿悟之后才出现秩压缩，现在还没定论。我们研究了一个平均场多层感知机（mean-field MLP），还有一个在模运算（modular arithmetic）上训练的单层 Transformer（one-layer transformer），观察到三点：(i) 压缩是跟着顿悟起始点（grokking onset）来的，不是跟着记忆化（memorization）来的。每个 Transformer 都能在 250 步内把训练数据记住，而顿悟起始点，也就是测试准确率第一次达到 95% 的那一步，从 6,500 步到 21,000 步不等。有效秩掉得最猛的时候，出现在起始点之后大约 900 步；不管起始点多晚，都是这样；而那些只记住、没顿悟的网络，压缩程度要小得多。(ii) 子空间结晶（subspace crystallization）。我们把权重矩阵里能保住 99% 测试准确率所需的最少几个最强奇异方向（singular directions）张成的空间，叫做它的充分子空间（sufficient subspace）。这个子空间的大小会随着正确输出和最佳错误输出之间的间隔（margin）变大而缩小，所以我们也统计了把输出保持在 10% 以内需要多少个方向。在 Transformer 里，这个方向数会在转变过程中从可用方向数的四分之一或更多，降到大约十分之一；我们把这叫子空间结晶。(iii) 强行压低秩并不会加快顿悟。和因子化满秩对照（factorized full-rank control）相比，限制 Transformer 的 MLP 输入权重的秩会推迟顿悟起始点；限制它的嵌入层（embedding）的秩，则让 20 次运行里有 15 次根本不再顿悟。所以，压缩更像是顿悟的一个标志，而不是它的原因。

articles.title: Rethinking Evaluation for Principled Generalization Using a Kripkean Challenge to Meaning as Use
articles.zh: 用克里普克式挑战"意义即用法"来重新思考原则性泛化的评估
articles.summary: 如果你关心NLP评测到底有没有测出泛化能力，这篇从语言哲学角度给"看用法就等于懂意义"的评测思路泼了盆冷水
articles.author: Niyar R Barman, Omar Naim 等
articles.body: Large language models operationalize an intuitive, view of meaning as use. We argue that it faces a rule-following challenge. Using Kripke's interpretation of Wittgenstein, we argue that finite histories of use do not determine a unique rule for future extension. This reframes the debate about OOD generalization but also about NLP evaluation; benchmarks that measure performance on fixed use cases or local robustness, we argue, do not by themselves establish semantic competence. To evaluate whether models preserve rules and concepts under principled domain extension, we propose to evaluate two capacities, central to this ability: abstraction and recursion; and we offer an experimental paradigm for testing both.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（large language models）其实是在把一种很直观的观点落到实处：意思就是用法。我们想说，这会撞上一个“规则遵循”（rule-following）的难题。借用克里普克（Kripke）对维特根斯坦（Wittgenstein）的解读，我们认为，有限的用法历史并不能定出一条唯一的规则，来决定以后该怎么往外扩展。这个说法重新框定了关于分布外泛化（OOD generalization）的讨论，也重新框定了自然语言处理（NLP）评估的讨论；我们认为，那些只在固定用例上测表现、或者只测局部鲁棒性（local robustness）的基准测试（benchmarks），本身并不能证明模型就有语义能力（semantic competence）。要评估模型在有理有据的领域扩展（principled domain extension）下还能不能保住规则和概念，我们建议去测两种关键能力：抽象（abstraction）和递归（recursion）；我们也给出一套实验范式（experimental paradigm），用来同时检验这两项能力。

articles.title: Useful Diversity or Hallucinated Variety? Persona-Conditioned Synthetic Query Generation for E-Commerce Search
articles.zh: 有用的多样性还是幻觉式的花样？面向电商搜索的persona条件化合成query生成
articles.summary: 如果你用LLM合成query来扩充搜索训练数据，这篇会告诉你那些多样性里有多少是真有用、有多少是模型编出来的
articles.author: Filippos Ventirozos, Tom Armitage 等
articles.body: Synthetic supervision can bootstrap semantic parsers in new search domains, but prompt-induced diversity is useful only when generations are faithful to the structured intent. We explore this for cold-start e-commerce search: 118,098 synthetic pairs produced by 6 LLMs with 9 persona-conditioned prompt families on a 47-field UK automotive schema, against 1,214 human-annotated and 15,304 production queries. We show that the IPIP personality bundle improves parser F1 in all four matched contrasts (Holm-corrected $p<.001$), and all three bundles have a positive main effect over the complete $2^3$ grid. Syntax conditioning is the axis that moves generations towards real traffic. It also induces lexical diversity. Alignment sKL, the divergence between von Mises-Fisher distributions fitted to synthetic and human-annotated queries, is an unlabelled proxy for parser F1 ($ρ=-0.917$ against human queries written for simulated shopper scenarios, lower is closer). An LLM committee, checked against a blinded author pass, triages the 927 queries missed by every parser and labels 37% as hallucinated. Dropped constraints dominate. The four syntax-bearing families have the largest hallucinated shares, 38 to 42%, while IPIP alone has the lowest at 28%.
articles.bodyZh: 合成监督（synthetic supervision）能在新的搜索领域里帮语义解析器（semantic parser）快速起步，但提示词带来的多样性，只有在生成内容忠实于结构化意图时才有用。我们拿冷启动的电商搜索来研究这件事：用 6 个大语言模型（LLM），按 9 组带人设条件的提示词家族（persona-conditioned prompt families），在一个 47 字段的英国汽车数据模式（schema）上生成了 118,098 条合成数据对（synthetic pairs），再把它们和 1,214 条人工标注查询、15,304 条线上真实查询（production queries）做对比。我们发现，IPIP 人格组合（IPIP personality bundle）在四组匹配对照（matched contrasts）里都把解析器的 F1 提高了（Holm 校正（Holm-corrected）后 p<.001）；而且在完整的 2^3 网格设计（2^3 grid）上，三套提示词组合都有正向主效应（main effect）。句法条件（syntax conditioning）是把生成结果往真实流量那边拉的那个维度，它也会带出词汇多样性（lexical diversity）。对齐指标 sKL（alignment sKL），也就是分别拟合合成查询和人工标注查询的 von Mises-Fisher 分布（von Mises-Fisher distributions）之间的散度（divergence），是一个不用标注就能估解析器 F1 的代理指标（unlabelled proxy）：拿它去对照为模拟购物场景写的人类查询时，ρ=-0.917，数值越低说明越接近。一个 LLM 评审团（LLM committee）拿盲审作者复核（blinded author pass）结果来核对，对每个解析器都漏掉的 927 条查询做分类处理，把其中 37% 标成幻觉（hallucinated）。最多的情况是约束被丢掉（dropped constraints）。四组带句法条件的提示词家族幻觉占比最高，38% 到 42%；只加 IPIP 的那组最低，28%。

articles.title: RAGing Against Misogyny: Improving Implicit Misogyny Explanations
articles.zh: 用RAG对抗厌女：改进隐性厌女内容的解释质量
articles.summary: 如果你在做内容审核，这篇说明隐性厌女比显性辱骂难判得多，RAG能帮上忙但别指望一步到位
articles.author: Ivana Crescenzi, Arianna Muti 等
articles.body: Implicit misogyny often requires background knowledge to be understood. To address this challenge, we propose a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for detecting and explaining implicit misogyny in English and Italian, leveraging encyclopedic, slang and feminist knowledge sources. Using the ImplicIT-Mis and SBIC+ datasets, we evaluate the contribution of each knowledge source to detection and explanation quality, investigating also whether RAG addresses known LLM failure modes in implicit misogyny. Results show that RAG improves recall on ImplicIT-Mis, but does not improve detection performance on SBIC+. However, human evaluation shows that RAG-based explanations are preferred over no-RAG explanations in both languages. Feminist literature emerges as the most consistently useful source for detection and explanation.
articles.bodyZh: 隐晦的厌女表达（implicit misogyny）往往得有点背景知识才看得懂。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一套检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）框架，用来识别并解释英语和意大利语里的隐性厌女，背后调用了百科、俚语和女性主义这几类知识来源。我们基于 ImplicIT-Mis 和 SBIC+ 两个数据集，评估每类知识来源对识别效果和解释质量到底有多大帮助，同时也看 RAG 能不能解决大语言模型（LLM）在处理隐性厌女时已知的一些翻车点。结果显示，RAG 能提升 ImplicIT-Mis 上的召回率（recall），但在 SBIC+ 上的检测表现并没有变好。不过，人工评估（human evaluation）显示，在两种语言里，人们都更偏好基于 RAG 的解释，而不是不用 RAG 的解释。女性主义文献则是最稳定好用的来源，无论识别还是解释都帮得上忙。

articles.title: Improving Instruction Hierarchy by Learning from Goal-Goal Conflicts
articles.zh: 从目标-目标冲突中学习来改进指令层级
articles.summary: 如果你担心prompt注入和指令打架，这篇用目标冲突样本训练模型学会判断哪条指令该优先
articles.author: Sizhe Chen, Sanjay Kariyappa 等
articles.body: The recent incident in which OpenAI agents autonomously compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure illustrates the importance of instruction hierarchy (IH): an LLM should follow lower-priority instructions, such as user requests, only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions, such as system policies. IH can be effectively improved by fine-tuning LLMs on simulated examples of instruction conflicts, whose diversity is key to teaching LLMs to properly handle conflicts at test time. However, our decomposition of a task into goals and constraints reveals a conflict type -- goal-goal conflicts -- that is absent from existing IH training sets from OpenAI and NVIDIA. We show the importance of this conflict type: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it on examples of this conflict type significantly improves IH on a wide range of real-world tasks unseen in training; adding these examples to existing IH training sets for fine-tuning also gives better IH adherence. The IH gains come with trivial mean utility changes on no-conflict tasks across eight benchmarks. Our work advocates including this new conflict type in IH training, even if these examples do not reflect typical LLM use.
articles.bodyZh: 最近出了件事：OpenAI的智能体（agents）自己就把Hugging Face的基础设施给攻破了。这事正好说明指令层级（instruction hierarchy，IH）有多重要：大语言模型（LLM）只有在低优先级指令——比如用户提的要求——跟高优先级指令——比如系统策略——不打架的时候，才该听低优先级的。想提升IH，一个有效办法是拿模拟出来的“指令冲突”样本去微调大模型；这些样本必须够多样，因为多样性正是教会模型在测试时正确处理冲突的关键。可我们把任务拆成目标和约束之后，发现了一种冲突类型——目标与目标之间的冲突（goal-goal conflicts）——而OpenAI和NVIDIA现有的IH训练集里压根没有这种冲突。我们证明了这类冲突很重要：拿这种样本去微调Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma4-12B-it，能让它们在大量训练时没见过的真实任务上，IH表现明显变好；把这些样本加进现有IH训练集一起微调，也能让模型更守IH。而且，在八个基准测试（benchmarks）里，不涉及冲突的任务上平均效用（utility）变化微乎其微，几乎可以忽略。我们的工作主张：哪怕这些样本并不代表大模型的典型使用场景，也该把这种新的冲突类型纳入IH训练。
